title: An inexact stochastic variance-reduced gradient method for constrained convex finite-sum optimization
why_read: A dense optimization theory paper improving complexity bounds for a specific constrained convex optimization setting.
analysis: This is a fairly technical operations-research/optimization paper proposing an improved stochastic gradient method for problems with hard constraints that must always be satisfied. It narrows a theoretical gap between two notions of approximate feasibility and also yields a new deterministic method for convex conic optimization as a special case. The content is mathematically rigorous but has limited immediate applicability outside optimization research communities. Engineers working on large-scale constrained ML or operations research may find it relevant, but it's a niche theoretical contribution.
